# ex: statement pattern with IncDecStmt and non-matching assignment RHS
ex {
	var x int
	x = x + 1 -> x++
}
-- x.go --
package p

func f() {
	var a int
	a = a + 1
	a = a + 2
	_ = a
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,7 +2,7 @@

 func f() {
 	var a int
-	a = a + 1
+	a++
 	a = a + 2
 	_ = a
 }
